q.x: If you are interested in buying an abandoned home in the Japan countryside highly recommend the YouTube channel Tokyo Llama. He's spent the last four years renovating a beautiful traditional style Japanese house and property about an hour outside of Tokyo.

If you are interested in buying an abandoned home in the Japan countryside highly recommend the YouTube channel Tokyo Llama.
